import re
import math

def simulate_test(doc, scope, inputs, params, start=None, horizon=None):
    if start is None:
        start = 0.0
    if horizon is None:
        horizon = 127.0
        
    objects = {}
    for inp in inputs:
        obj_id = inp["entities"][0]
        fields = inp["fields"]
        mat = fields.get("material", "metal")
        mass = 2.0 if mat == "metal" else 1.0
        objects[obj_id] = {
            "id": obj_id,
            "mass": mass,
            "x": fields.get("x", 0.0),
            "y": fields.get("y", 0.0),
            "vx": fields.get("vx", 0.0),
            "vy": fields.get("vy", 0.0),
            "entry_time": inp["time"]
        }
            
    friction = 0.01
    for obj in objects.values():
        dt = start - obj["entry_time"]
        if dt > 0:
            t_sim = 0.0
            step = 0.1
            while t_sim < dt:
                s = math.hypot(obj["vx"], obj["vy"])
                if s > 0.1:
                    obj["vx"] -= friction * step * obj["vx"] / s
                    obj["vy"] -= friction * step * obj["vy"] / s
                obj["x"] += obj["vx"] * step
                obj["y"] += obj["vy"] * step
                t_sim += step
            if abs(obj["vx"]) < 0.001: obj["vx"] = 0.0
            if abs(obj["vy"]) < 0.001: obj["vy"] = 0.0
            
    outcomes = []
    obj_list = list(objects.values())
    
    t = start
    dt = 0.1
    while t < horizon:
        for obj in obj_list:
            s = math.hypot(obj["vx"], obj["vy"])
            if s > 0.1:
                obj["vx"] -= friction * dt * obj["vx"] / s
                obj["vy"] -= friction * dt * obj["vy"] / s
            obj["x"] += obj["vx"] * dt
            obj["y"] += obj["vy"] * dt
            if abs(obj["vx"]) < 0.001: obj["vx"] = 0.0
            if abs(obj["vy"]) < 0.001: obj["vy"] = 0.0
            
        for i in range(len(obj_list)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(obj_list)):
                o1 = obj_list[i]
                o2 = obj_list[j]
                dx = o2["x"] - o1["x"]
                dy = o2["y"] - o1["y"]
                dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
                if dist <= 0.4 and dist > 0.01:
                    nx = dx / dist
                    ny = dy / dist
                    dvx = o1["vx"] - o2["vx"]
                    dvy = o1["vy"] - o2["vy"]
                    dvn = dvx * nx + dvy * ny
                    if dvn > 0:
                        m1, m2 = o1["mass"], o2["mass"]
                        imp = 2 * dvn / (m1 + m2)
                        o1["vx"] -= imp * m2 * nx
                        o1["vy"] -= imp * m2 * ny
                        o2["vx"] += imp * m1 * nx
                        o2["vy"] += imp * m1 * ny
                        overlap = 0.4 - dist
                        sep = overlap / 2 + 0.01
                        o1["x"] -= sep * nx
                        o1["y"] -= sep * ny
                        o2["x"] += sep * nx
                        o2["y"] += sep * ny
                        outcomes.append({
                            "time": round(t, 1),
                            "kind": "collision",
                            "entities": [o1["id"], o2["id"]],
                            "value": None,
                            "src": []
                        })
        t += dt
    return outcomes

# Test on Video 14930
scope = "Video 14930"
ins = inputs(doc, scope)
rec_outs = outcomes(doc, scope)
sim_outs = simulate_test(doc, scope, ins, {}, start=50.0, horizon=85.0)

print("Recorded outcomes (t>50):")
for o in rec_outs:
    if o["time"] > 50:
        print(f"  t={o['time']}: {o['entities']}")
        
print("\nSimulated outcomes:")
for o in sim_outs:
    print(f"  t={o['time']}: {o['entities']}")

import re
import math

def simulate_debug(doc, scope, inputs, params, start=None, horizon=None):
    if start is None:
        start = 0.0
    if horizon is None:
        horizon = 127.0
        
    objects = {}
    for inp in inputs:
        obj_id = inp["entities"][0]
        fields = inp["fields"]
        mat = fields.get("material", "metal")
        objects[obj_id] = {
            "id": obj_id,
            "mat": mat,
            "x": fields.get("x", 0.0),
            "y": fields.get("y", 0.0),
            "vx": fields.get("vx", 0.0),
            "vy": fields.get("vy", 0.0),
            "entry_time": inp["time"]
        }
            
    friction = 0.005
    for obj in objects.values():
        dt = start - obj["entry_time"]
        if dt > 0:
            t_sim = 0.0
            step = 0.1
            while t_sim < dt:
                s = math.hypot(obj["vx"], obj["vy"])
                if s > 0.1:
                    obj["vx"] -= friction * step * obj["vx"] / s
                    obj["vy"] -= friction * step * obj["vy"] / s
                obj["x"] += obj["vx"] * step
                obj["y"] += obj["vy"] * step
                t_sim += step
                
    outcomes = []
    obj_list = list(objects.values())
    
    t = start
    dt = 0.1
    collision_pairs = set()
    while t < horizon:
        for obj in obj_list:
            s = math.hypot(obj["vx"], obj["vy"])
            if s > 0.1:
                obj["vx"] -= friction * dt * obj["vx"] / s
                obj["vy"] -= friction * dt * obj["vy"] / s
            obj["x"] += obj["vx"] * dt
            obj["y"] += obj["vy"] * dt
            
        for i in range(len(obj_list)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(obj_list)):
                o1 = obj_list[i]
                o2 = obj_list[j]
                dx = o2["x"] - o1["x"]
                dy = o2["y"] - o1["y"]
                dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
                if dist <= 0.42:
                    pair = tuple(sorted([o1["id"], o2["id"]]))
                    if pair not in collision_pairs:
                        collision_pairs.add(pair)
                        outcomes.append({
                            "time": round(t, 1),
                            "kind": "collision",
                            "entities": list(pair),
                            "value": None,
                            "src": []
                        })
                        # elastic collision
                        nx, ny = dx/dist, dy/dist
                        dvx = o1["vx"] - o2["vx"]
                        dvy = o1["vy"] - o2["vy"]
                        dvn = dvx * nx + dvy * ny
                        if dvn > 0:
                            o1["vx"] -= dvn * nx
                            o1["vy"] -= dvn * ny
                            o2["vx"] += dvn * nx
                            o2["vy"] += dvn * ny
        t += dt
    return outcomes, objects

sim_outs, objs = simulate_debug(doc, scope, ins, {}, start=50.0, horizon=85.0)
